privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Misk Fragrances operates this store and website to provide you with a curated shopping experience. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and disclose your personal information when you visit, use, or make a purchase through our Services.
privacyPolicy.acknowledge: Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By using and accessing the Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the collection, use, and disclosure of your information as described herein.
privacyPolicy.contactNote: Questions about this policy or want to exercise your rights?

sections.title: Personal Information We Collect
sections.content: When we use the term "personal information," we are referring to information that identifies or can reasonably be linked to you or another person. Personal information does not include information that is collected anonymously or that has been de-identified. We may collect or process the following categories of personal information depending on how you interact with the Services:
bullets: Contact details — name, address, billing & shipping address, phone number, and email address.
Financial information — credit/debit card numbers, payment details, transaction history, and payment confirmation.
Account information — username, password, security questions, preferences and settings.
Transaction information — items viewed, added to cart or wishlist, purchased, returned, exchanged or cancelled.
Communications — information you include when sending us a customer support inquiry.
Device information — device type, browser, IP address, network connection, and unique identifiers.
Usage information — how and when you interact with or navigate the Services.

sections.title: Personal Information Sources
sections.content: We may collect personal information from the following sources:
bullets: Directly from you — when you create an account, visit or use the Services, communicate with us, or otherwise provide information.
Automatically through the Services — from your device via cookies and similar  technologies.
From our service providers — when we engage them to enable technology or when they collect data on our behalf.
From our partners or other third parties.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Depending on how you interact with us, we may use personal information for the following purposes:
bullets: Provide & Improve Services — process payments, fulfill orders, manage your account, arrange shipping, and create a personalized shopping experience.
Marketing & Advertising — send promotional communications by email, text, or mail, and show relevant online advertisements.
Security & Fraud Prevention — authenticate your account, detect fraudulent activity, and secure our services.
Communicating with You — provide customer support and maintain our business relationship.
Legal Compliance — comply with applicable law, respond to legal process, and enforce our terms and policies.

sections.title: How We Disclose Your Information
sections.content: In certain circumstances, we may disclose your personal information to third parties for legitimate purposes, including:
bullets: Our technology platform and service vendors — IT management, payment processing, analytics, cloud storage, fulfillment and shipping.
Business and marketing partners — for marketing services and advertising.
At your direction — when you consent to sharing with third parties, such as for shipping or social media integrations.
Corporate affiliates — within our corporate group.
Business transactions — mergers, legal obligations, enforcement of terms, or protection of rights.

sections.title: Our Technology Infrastructure
sections.content:
Our store is built on a sophisticated technology infrastructure designed to deliver a secure, seamless shopping experience. Information you submit may be transmitted to technical service providers and third parties that may be located in countries other than where you reside.

Our technical service providers are responsible for processing your personal information for certain purposes, including responding to your rights requests related to those purposes.

sections.title: Third Party Websites & Links
sections.content:
The Services may provide links to websites operated by third parties. If you follow links to sites not affiliated with us, you should review their privacy and security policies. We do not guarantee and are not responsible for the privacy or security of such sites.

Information you share on third-party social platforms may be viewable by other users without limitation. Our inclusion of such links does not imply any endorsement.

sections.title: Children's Data
sections.content:
The Services are not intended for children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information about children under the age of majority in your jurisdiction. If you are the parent or guardian of a child who has provided us with their personal information, please contact us to request deletion.

As of the Effective Date of this Privacy Policy, we do not have actual knowledge that we "share" or "sell" personal information of individuals under 16 years of age.

sections.title: Security & Retention
sections.content:
No security measures are perfect or impenetrable, and we cannot guarantee "perfect security." We recommend that you do not use unsecure channels to communicate sensitive or confidential information to us.

How long we retain your personal information depends on factors such as whether we need it to maintain your account, provide Services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce applicable contracts and policies.

sections.title: Your Rights & Choices
sections.content: Depending on where you live, you may have some or all of the rights below. These rights are not absolute and may apply only in certain circumstances.
bullets: Right to Access / Know — request access to personal information we hold about you.
Right to Delete — request deletion of personal information we maintain about you.
Right to Correct — request correction of inaccurate personal information.
Right of Portability — receive a copy of your data and request transfer to a third party.
Communication Preferences — opt out of promotional emails at any time via the unsubscribe link.
sections.note: You may exercise any of these rights where indicated on the Services or by contacting us. We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights. We may need to verify your identity before processing your request.

sections.title: Complaints
sections.content: If you have complaints about how we process your personal information, please contact us using the contact details below. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to appeal our decision or lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.title: International Transfers
sections.content:
Please note that we may transfer, store and process your personal information outside the country you live in.

If we transfer your personal information out of the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we will rely on recognized transfer mechanisms like the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, unless the transfer is to a country with an adequate level of protection.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, including to reflect changes to our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will post the revised Privacy Policy on this website, update the Last updated date, and provide notice as required by applicable law.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: Should you have any questions about our privacy practices or this Privacy Policy, or if you would like to exercise any of the rights available to you, please email us at Misk@gmail.com or contact us at Cairo Festival City, Nasr City, C, 0000, EG.

returnPolicy.title: Return & Exchange Policy
returnPolicy.intro: At Misk, we are committed to providing high-quality perfumes crafted with exceptional attention to detail. This policy outlines the terms under which refunds may be requested, ensuring full transparency and fairness for all customers.
returnPolicy.footerNote: For any questions regarding this policy, please don't hesitate to

sections.title: Performance-Based Refund Guarantee
sections.content: We offer a refund guarantee solely based on performance. If the perfume's longevity or projection does not meet the expected level, you may request a refund or choose another scent.

sections.title: Eligibility for Refund
sections.content: To qualify for a refund, all of the following conditions must be met:
bullets: The perfume must be in its original condition, free from any damage or misuse.
The external packaging must be included.
Opening the bottle for testing purposes is permitted.
Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of receiving your order.
Refunds will not be issued due to personal dislike of the scent.

sections.title: Exchange Policy
bullets: No exchanges are permitted for any reason.
sections.note: All orders are considered final, and exchanges are not accepted under any circumstances.

sections.title: How to Request a Refund
sections.content: To submit a refund request, please contact our support team through our official communication channels. Our team will guide you through the process and assist you promptly.

sections.title: Additional Notes
bullets: Refunds will be processed only after the returned item is received and inspected.
Shipping fees (if any) are non-refundable.
Any misuse, intentional damage, or missing packaging will void the refund eligibility.

items.q: What is Misk's return and exchange policy?
items.a: Your satisfaction is our priority. We offer a 7-day exchange policy on all products, provided they are unused and in their original packaging. Simply reach out to our support team with your order number and we'll handle the rest.

items.q: How do I use the satisfaction guarantee?
items.a: Every purchase is backed by our satisfaction guarantee. If you're not completely happy with your order for any reason, contact us within 7 days of receiving it — we'll make it right with an exchange or store credit.

items.q: How long does the fragrance last and what's its sillage like?
items.a: Our fragrances are Extrait De Parfum (30–35% concentration), delivering an exceptional 8–14 hours of longevity and a moderate to strong sillage that fills every room with elegance. Apply to pulse points — wrists, neck, and behind the ears — for an unforgettable scent experience.

items.q: Can I return a perfume if I don't like the scent?
items.a: We want you to shop with complete confidence. We recommend carefully reading the fragrance notes on each product page before purchasing. If you need guidance finding your perfect scent, our team is always ready to help.

items.q: How much does shipping cost and how long does delivery take?
items.a: Enjoy completely free shipping on all orders over 2,000 EGP. A flat, affordable shipping fee applies to orders below that threshold. Your order arrives within 2–4 business days anywhere in Egypt.
